> For AI agents: the complete documentation index is available at /AchEngine/en/llms.txt, the full documentation bundle is available at /AchEngine/en/llms-full.txt.

# AchTimer

`AchTimer` is an async/await timer utility for simple delays and progress tracking.

## Simple waits

```csharp
await AchTimer.Wait(3f);
await AchTimer.WaitRealtime(3f);
```

`Wait` uses game time; `WaitRealtime` uses unscaled time and is unaffected by slow motion or pause.

## Track progress with `AchTimerHandle`

```csharp
var timer = AchTimer.Start(5f);
await timer;
```

| Property      | Description                         |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `Duration`    | Total duration in seconds           |
| `Elapsed`     | Elapsed seconds                     |
| `Remaining`   | Remaining seconds, never below zero |
| `Progress`    | 0 to 1 completion ratio             |
| `IsDone`      | Completed or canceled               |
| `IsCancelled` | Canceled state                      |
| `Task`        | Task representing completion        |

`await timer` and `await timer.Task` are equivalent. Cancellation raises `TaskCanceledException`.

```csharp
var timer = AchTimer.Start(10f);
if (playerDied)
    timer.Cancel();
```

Use `useUnscaledTime: true` for a real-time timer and pass a `CancellationToken` when an external owner should cancel it.

```csharp
var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
await AchTimer.Wait(10f, cts.Token);
var timer = AchTimer.Start(10f, cancellationToken: cts.Token);
```

## `UIAchTimer`

Bind a handle to optional `Text` and `Slider` fields to display remaining/elapsed time and progress.

```csharp
var timer = AchTimer.Start(5f);
GetComponent<UIAchTimer>().Bind(timer);
await timer;
```

The component unbinds automatically when the timer completes; call `Unbind()` manually when needed.

## Complete example

```csharp
var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
var castTimer = AchTimer.Start(2f, cancellationToken: cts.Token);
castBar.Bind(castTimer);

try
{
    await castTimer;
    FireSkill();
}
catch (TaskCanceledException)
{
    ShowCancelMessage();
}
```

- [UI system overview](/AchEngine/en/usage/ui.md)
- [Button extension components](/AchEngine/en/usage/ui/button-extras.md)

# UIBindingManager *(ACHENGINE_R3)*

`UIBindingManager` is a type-safe pub/sub bus built on R3 `Subject<T>`. It is enabled only when `com.cysharp.r3` is installed.

## Publish

```csharp
public struct GoldChangedMessage
{
    public int Amount;
}

UIBindingManager.Publish(new GoldChangedMessage { Amount = 500 });
```

## Subscribe

Store the returned `IDisposable` and dispose it when the view is disabled or destroyed.

```csharp
private IDisposable _subscription;

private void OnEnable()
{
    _subscription = UIBindingManager.Subscribe<GoldChangedMessage>(message =>
    {
        goldLabel.text = message.Amount.ToString();
    });
}

private void OnDisable() => _subscription?.Dispose();
```

## Utilities

```csharp
bool exists = UIBindingManager.Contains<GoldChangedMessage>();
UIBindingManager.ClearAll();
```

| Method                    | Description                           |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `Publish<T>(T)`           | Publish a message                     |
| `Subscribe<T>(Action<T>)` | Subscribe and return an `IDisposable` |
| `Contains<T>()`           | Check whether a subject exists        |
| `ClearAll()`              | Remove every subject                  |

Without R3, the manager is excluded from compilation.

url: /AchEngine/en/usage/ui/button-extras.md

# Button Extension Components

`AchButtonCooldown` and `AchButtonHold` are components added beside a standard Unity `Button`. Both require a `Button` on the same GameObject.

## `AchButtonCooldown`

Disables the button after a click and enables it again after the configured duration. It can display a countdown label.

| Inspector field     | Description                           |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `Cooldown`          | Minimum delay in seconds; default `1` |
| `Show Countdown`    | Display remaining time                |
| `Countdown Label`   | Optional `Text` target                |
| `On Cooldown Start` | UnityEvent fired at start             |
| `On Cooldown End`   | UnityEvent fired at end               |

| API               | Description                                 |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `IsCoolingDown`   | Current state                               |
| `StartCooldown()` | Start or restart the cooldown               |
| `ResetCooldown()` | Clear the cooldown and re-enable the button |

```csharp
var cooldown = GetComponent<AchButtonCooldown>();
cooldown.StartCooldown();
cooldown.ResetCooldown();
if (!cooldown.IsCoolingDown)
    Debug.Log("Button is ready");
```

## `AchButtonHold`

Fires a UnityEvent repeatedly while the button is held. It is useful for quantity controls and volume adjustments.

| Inspector field   | Description                                  |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `Initial Delay`   | Delay before the first repeat; default `0.5` |
| `Repeat Interval` | Time between repeats; default `0.1`          |
| `On Hold Fire`    | Repeated UnityEvent                          |

| API         | Description                          |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `IsHolding` | Whether the button is currently held |

```csharp
public void IncreaseVolume()
{
    AudioManager.Volume = Mathf.Clamp01(AudioManager.Volume + 0.05f);
}
```

## Use both components

```text
[Button GameObject]
├── Button
├── AchButtonCooldown
└── AchButtonHold
```

- [AchTimer](/AchEngine/en/usage/timer.md)

# Draggable & Touch Objects

AchEngine provides components for dragging and tapping 2D world objects.

## `Draggable`

Derive from `Draggable` to receive mouse/touch drag events. A missing `Physics2DRaycaster` is added to the main camera automatically.

```csharp
public class CardView : Draggable
{
    protected override void Start()
    {
        base.Start();
        OnTouchDown += () => Debug.Log("Picked up");
        OnTouching += position => Debug.Log($"Dragging: {position}");
        OnTouchUp += hits => Debug.Log($"Dropped on {hits.Length} colliders");
    }
}
```

| Event         | Signature              | Description                        |
| ------------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `OnTouchDown` | `Action`               | Pointer pressed                    |
| `OnTouching`  | `Action<Vector3>`      | Dragging world position            |
| `OnTouchUp`   | `Action<Collider2D[]>` | Dropped with overlapping colliders |

`originalPos` stores the world position at the beginning of a drag.

## `TouchableObject`

Override `OnTouched()` for a tap/click-only object.

```csharp
public class EnemyObject : TouchableObject
{
    protected override void OnTouched() => Debug.Log("Enemy clicked");
}
```

## `ObjectTouchManager`

Add one `ObjectTouchManager` to the scene. It detects left-clicks each frame, raycasts in 2D, and invokes `OnTouched()` on the hit `TouchableObject`.

# UI System — Overview

AchEngine UI provides layer-based view management, pooling, transitions, bindings, and editor tooling.

## Core components

| Component                        | Role                                  |
| -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `UIRoot`                         | Owns UI layers and the view catalog   |
| `UIView`                         | Base class for screens and popups     |
| `UIViewCatalog`                  | Maps view IDs to prefabs and settings |
| `UIBootstrapper`                 | Opens configured views at scene start |
| `UIOpenButton` / `UICloseButton` | Inspector-driven navigation           |
| `UISafeAreaFitter`               | Avoids notch and punch-hole areas     |

## Layer structure

```mermaid
flowchart TB
Root[UIRoot] --> Background
Root --> Screen
Root --> Popup
Root --> Tooltip
Root --> Overlay
```

## Open and close a view

```csharp
var ui = ServiceLocator.Resolve<IUIService>();
ui.Show<MainMenuView>();
ui.Show("SettingsPopup");
ui.Close<MainMenuView>();
ui.CloseAll();
```

## Next steps

- [UIView & lifecycle](/AchEngine/en/usage/ui/views.md)
- [UI Workspace](/AchEngine/en/usage/ui/workspace.md)

# RedDot System

`RedDot` is a static facade for notification badges. Keys separated by `/` form a hierarchy, and child counts are aggregated into their parents.

## API

```csharp
RedDot.Set("Shop/New", 3);
RedDot.Add("Quest/Daily", 1);
int count = RedDot.Get("Shop");
bool visible = RedDot.HasDot("Shop");
RedDot.Clear("Quest/Daily");
RedDot.Subscribe("Shop", OnShopChanged);
RedDot.Unsubscribe("Shop", OnShopChanged);
```

`RedDot.ClearAll()` resets every key to zero, which is useful during scene transitions or a new game session.

```csharp
RedDot.ClearAll();
SceneManager.LoadScene("MainMenu");
```

## Hierarchy

```text
Shop       → Shop/New + Shop/Sale
Shop/New   → direct count
Shop/Sale  → direct count
```

## `RedDotBadge`

Attach `RedDotBadge` to a UI object to toggle a dot object and optional count label automatically.

| Field            | Description                                         |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `Key`            | Key to observe, such as `Shop` or `Quest/Daily`     |
| `Dot`            | GameObject enabled when count > 0                   |
| `Count Label`    | Optional `Text`; shown for counts of 2 or more      |
| `Clear On Click` | Automatically clear on button click; default `true` |
| `Button`         | Button used for click clearing                      |

The component subscribes in `OnEnable` and unsubscribes in `OnDisable`.

## Direct subscription

```csharp
private void OnEnable() => RedDot.Subscribe("Shop", OnShopChanged);
private void OnDisable() => RedDot.Unsubscribe("Shop", OnShopChanged);

private void OnShopChanged(int count)
{
    _shopButton.SetDotVisible(count > 0);
}
```

RedDot resets its static state on `SubsystemRegistration`, so it also works when Enter Play Mode is configured without Domain Reload.

- [UI system overview](/AchEngine/en/usage/ui.md)
- [UIView & lifecycle](/AchEngine/en/usage/ui/views.md)

# UIView & Lifecycle

`UIView` is the base class for every screen in the AchEngine UI system.

## Lifecycle

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
direction TB
[*] --> Unborn
Unborn --> Initializing : first instance
Initializing --> Idle : OnInitialize()
Pool --> Idle : get from pool
Idle --> Opening : Show()
Opening --> Visible : OnOpened()
Visible --> Closing : Close()
Closing --> Idle : OnClosed()
Idle --> Pool : return when Pool Size > 0
Idle --> [*] : destroy when Pool Size = 0
```

## Implement a view

```csharp
using AchEngine.UI;
using UnityEngine.UI;

public class ItemDetailView : UIView
{
    [SerializeField] private Text _nameText;
    [SerializeField] private Text _descText;
    private ItemData _item;

    protected override void OnInitialize()
        => _closeButton.onClick.AddListener(CloseSelf);

    public void SetItem(ItemData item) => _item = item;

    protected override void OnOpened(object payload)
    {
        _nameText.text = _item.Name;
        _descText.text = _item.Description;
    }

    protected override void OnClosed() => _item = null;
}
```

## Single-instance mode

Enable **Single Instance** on the catalog entry when repeated calls should reuse one view. Configure its layer in `UIViewCatalog`; do not override a layer property in the view subclass.

## Object pool

Set **Pool Size** to at least 1 to return closed views to the pool instead of destroying them. Reset transient state in `OnClosed()`.

## Create a view prefab

```text
[GameObject]
├── Canvas Group (fade transition)
├── UIView
└── UI elements
```

Register the prefab in `UIViewCatalog`, then assign the catalog to `UIRoot`.

| Field         | Description                                |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| **ID**        | String passed to `Show("ID")`              |
| **Prefab**    | Prefab containing `UIView`                 |
| **Layer**     | Render layer                               |
| **Pool Size** | Pre-created instances; 0 creates on demand |

## Useful components

- `UICloseButton` closes the nearest parent `UIView`.
- `UIOpenButton` opens a configured view ID.
- `UISafeAreaFitter` avoids notch/punch-hole areas. `UIRoot` adds it automatically to `Screen`, `Popup`, and `Tooltip`.
- `UIBootstrapper` opens configured views when a scene starts.

## Transitions

Override `OnBeforeOpen(object payload)` and `OnBeforeClose()` to start custom animations. The configured `UITransitionSettings` controls when closing and pooling finish. Set Transition Mode to `None` for a fully custom animation.

```csharp
protected override void OnBeforeOpen(object payload)
{
    _panel.anchoredPosition = new Vector2(Screen.width, 0);
    _panel.DOAnchorPosX(0, 0.3f).SetEase(Ease.OutCubic);
}
```

url: /AchEngine/en/usage/ui/workspace.md

# Using UI Workspace

UI Workspace creates the scene UI root, manages the view catalog, and provides Editor diagnostics.

## Initial setup

### 1. Create `UIRoot`

Open **Project Settings › AchEngine › UI Workspace** and click **Create UI Root**, or place a `UIRoot` prefab in the scene.

### 2. Create `UIViewCatalog`

Create **Create › Achieve › UI View Catalog** and assign it to `UIRoot`.

### 3. Register view prefabs

Add each `UIView` prefab to the catalog and configure its ID, layer, pool size, and single-instance setting.

## Open and close views

```csharp
var ui = ServiceLocator.Resolve<IUIService>();
ui.Show<MainMenuView>();
ui.Show("SettingsPopup");
ui.Close<MainMenuView>();
ui.CloseAll();
```

## View prefab structure

```text
[View Prefab]
├── Canvas Group
├── UIView
└── child UI elements
```

Use `OnInitialize()` for one-time wiring, `OnOpened(object payload)` for each open, and `OnClosed()` to clear state.

## Pool and single instance

Set **Pool Size** above zero to reuse instances. Enable **Single Instance** when a view ID should have only one active instance.

## `UIBootstrapper`

Add `UIBootstrapper` to a scene and populate **Auto Open Views** with the catalog IDs that should open at startup.

## Useful components

- `UICloseButton` closes the nearest parent view.
- `UIOpenButton` opens the configured target view ID.
- `UISafeAreaFitter` applies safe-area padding to a custom Canvas or layer. `UIRoot` applies it automatically to `Screen`, `Popup`, and `Tooltip`.

## Unity 6 editor toolbar

The **AchEngine/Scene Navigator** toolbar lists Build Settings scenes, shows the active edit scene, checks unsaved changes before navigation, refreshes after scene or Build Settings changes, and disables navigation during Play Mode.

## UI Workspace window

The workspace window can:

- list all registered views in the scene;
- force-open or close a view while playing in the Editor;
- show live view state by layer; and
- warn about `UIView` components that are not registered in the catalog.

> For AI agents: the complete documentation index is available at /AchEngine/en/llms.txt, the full documentation bundle is available at /AchEngine/en/llms-full.txt.

# HttpLink

`HttpLink` wraps Unity `UnityWebRequest` with a builder API for GET/POST, JSON serialization, headers, and timeouts.

## GET

```csharp
var result = await new HttpLink.Builder()
    .SetUrl("https://api.example.com/users/1")
    .AddHeader("Authorization", "Bearer token123")
    .SetTimeout(10)
    .GetAsync<UserData>();
```

## POST

```csharp
string json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(new LoginRequest { UserId = "abc", Password = "pw" });

bool success = await new HttpLink.Builder()
    .SetUrl("https://api.example.com/login")
    .SetJsonBody(json)
    .PostAsync();
```

## Send directly

Use `Build().SendAsync()` when you need the raw response or status.

```csharp
var link = await new HttpLink.Builder()
    .SetUrl("https://api.example.com/data")
    .SetMethod(UnityWebRequest.kHttpVerbGET)
    .Build()
    .SendAsync();

if (link.Success)
    Debug.Log(link.ReceiveDataString);
```

## Builder API

| Method                      | Description                                                  |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `SetUrl(string)`            | Request URL                                                  |
| `SetMethod(string)`         | `GET` or `POST`; other methods throw `NotSupportedException` |
| `SetTimeout(int)`           | Timeout in seconds                                           |
| `SetJsonBody(string)`       | JSON body with `application/json`                            |
| `AddHeader(string, string)` | Request header                                               |
| `GetAsync<T>()`             | GET and JSON deserialize                                     |
| `PostAsync()`               | POST and return success                                      |
| `Build()`                   | Create an `HttpLink`                                         |

## `HttpLink` properties

| Property            | Description                   |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| `Success`           | Whether the request succeeded |
| `Result`            | `UnityWebRequest.Result`      |
| `ReceiveDataString` | Response body as text         |
| `ReceiveData`       | Response bytes                |
| `DownloadSize`      | Downloaded bytes              |
| `DownloadProgress`  | Progress from 0 to 1          |

JSON serialization uses `Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert`.
